# The tracked lines outside history that write `needs` or `provides` before a comma
# list of names (196n acceptance check 2). TestRowResidue selects the lines that hold
# needs or provides with git grep -F, finds rowResidueWord (Go's regexp) in them over
# every path but the skipped prefixes below, and fails on a match no row covers and on
# a row that covers no match. A row is `path<TAB>excerpt`:
# the excerpt is text of one line of the file that contains the match; `*` covers the
# whole file.

# skipped: the history list of the 196n spec (docs/research/ef-migrate/*.ergo is parsed
# in the current syntax and stays checked), the old-syntax parser and its inputs
